[[Business Consulting]] {{cite web |url= https://www.onwardgroup.com/images/company/onward-technologies-wins-d-b-business-excellence-award-2021.pdf |title= Onward Technologies wins Dun & Bradstreet's Business Excellence Award |date=24 November 2021 |website=onwardgroup.com |access-date=13 May 2022}} | products = | parent = | revenue = {{profit}} {{INRConvert|550.9|c}} {{small|(FY26)}}{{Cite web |title=Press Release and Consolidated Audited Financial Results of the Company for Year ended March 31, 2026 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/ea01215a-bbaf-4bd5-a6b4-f4a863a45583.pdf |website=bseindia.com}} | operating_income = | net_income = {{profit}} {{INRConvert|46.7|c}} (FY26) | assets = | equity = | num_employees = 2,485 (FY26) | website = {{URL|https://onwardgroup.com/}} }} '''Onward Technologies''' is an Indian multinational [[software technology]] [[outsourcing]] company specializing in digital and ER&D services for the transportation & mobility, industrial equipment, heavy machinery, and healthcare & med-tech industries. As per its filings with the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]], it is reported to be headquartered in [[Mumbai]] and has 2,485 employees across 12 offices in 6 countries as well as offshore development centers in India. As of 31 March 2026, it has one Indian subsidiary and four foreign subsidiaries.{{Cite web |title=Press Release and Consolidated Audited Financial Results of the Company for Year ended March 31, 2026 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/ea01215a-bbaf-4bd5-a6b4-f4a863a45583.pdf |website=bseindia.com}}{{Cite web |title=Outcome of Board Meeting held on May 5, 2026. |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/1a09925d-cf28-4166-8d8c-2bfe6b57121b.pdf |website=bseindia.com}} == Revenues == According to its filing with the BSE Limited, Onward Technologies reported FY26 revenue of ₹550.9 crore, reflecting a 10.5% YoY growth.{{Cite web |title=Press Release and Consolidated Audited Financial Results of the Company for Year ended March 31, 2026 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/ea01215a-bbaf-4bd5-a6b4-f4a863a45583.pdf |website=bseindia.com}} The company also reported EBITDA of ₹71.9 crore, up 60.9% YoY, and PAT* of ₹46.7 crore, up 72.3% YoY.{{Cite web |title=Press Release and Consolidated Audited Financial Results of the Company for Year ended March 31, 2026 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/ea01215a-bbaf-4bd5-a6b4-f4a863a45583.pdf |website=bseindia.com}}{{Cite web |title=Submission of Earnings Presentation for the Quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/1fec662c-a553-49f6-ad3b-344200828539.pdf |website=bseindia.com}} == History == === 1991–1996 === Onward Technologies was founded in August 1991 by [[Harish S. Mehta|Harish Mehta]], a first-generation entrepreneur, one of the founders and the first elected Chairman{{Cite web |title=Microsoft or Google may not spring from India, says IT industry veteran Harish Mehta |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/microsoft-or-google-may-not-spring-from-india-says-it-industry-veteran-harish-mehta-1945778-2022-05-05 |website=indiatoday.in|date=5 May 2022 }} of the National Association of Software and Service Companies ([[NASSCOM]]). The company listed on the BSE & [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] in 1995. Harish Mehta served as a CEO.{{Cite web |title=INVESTOR PRESENTATION MARCH 2021 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/641dbb74-0e6e-4c0d-9ba7-c2bb19519dc3.pdf |website=bseindia.com}} === 1997–2010 === In 1997, the company expanded into the US with its subsidiary, Onward Technologies, Inc. becoming operational.{{Cite web |title=ONWARD TECHNOLOGIES LTD MARCH 1997 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/HIS_ANN_RPT/HISTANNR/1997/ONWARD_TECHNOLOGIES_LTD-517536-MARCH-1997.PDF |website=bseindia.com}} In 1998, the company also set up a branch office in London{{Cite web |title=ONWARD TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED |url=https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/FC021336 |website=find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk}} Between 2001 and 2010, the company had diversified into the Engineering, Research & Development (ER&D) industry while also achieving [[ISO 9000|ISO 9001]] & [[ISO 27001]] certifications for its offshore development centers in India. It had also opened offices in Chicago in this interim.{{Cite web |title=Corpfiling |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/Attachhis/5bb40a8e-8264-44d6-b0ff-f50249a51e9b.pdf |website=bseindia.com}} === 2010 – present === In May 2016, Jigar Mehta (Harish Mehta's son) was appointed as the managing director.{{Cite web |title=Annual Report |url=https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/517536/5175360316.pdf |website=bseindia.com |access-date=20 July 2022 |archive-date=29 March 2024 with BSE confirms that it continues to be Net-Debt Free.{{Cite web |title=Submission of Annual Report of Onward Technologies Limited Onward Technologies is an Indian multinational software technology outsourcing company specializing in digital and ER&D services for the transportation & mobility, industrial equipment, heavy machinery, and healthcare & med-tech industries.
As per its filings with the BSE, it is reported to be headquartered in Mumbai and has 2,485 employees across 12 offices in 6 countries as well as offshore development centers in India. As of 31 March 2026, it has one Indian subsidiary and four foreign subsidiaries.
